latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image Video Creator — Turn Images Into MP4 Videos

- Create 1080p MP4 slideshow videos from up to five JPG images in under a minute.
- Simple workflow: upload product images, describe the video you want, and download the result—no manual editing required.
- Automatic connection to the cloud rendering API with free anonymous token support.
- Supports music, transitions, text overlays, and various video, image, and audio formats (MP4, MOV, JPG, MP3, etc.).
- Built-in error handling (credits, file types, plan requirements) and clear user feedback at each step.
- Preserves session state for iterative edits and quick previews of video timelines.
